preconditions.description: The number of notes n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2*10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each note position a_i is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(b_i) <= 5 for b_i in return_value.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no convenient fingering, or a sequence of n integers each between 1 and 5.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all((a[i] < a[i+1] and int(return_value.split()[i]) < int(return_value.split()[i+1])) or (a[i] > a[i+1] and int(return_value.split()[i]) > int(return_value.split()[i+1])) or (a[i] == a[i+1] and int(return_value.split()[i]) != int(return_value.split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: If a convenient fingering exists, it satisfies the conditions: if a_i < a_{i+1} then b_i < b_{i+1}, if a_i > a_{i+1} then b_i > b_{i+1}, and if a_i = a_{i+1} then b_i ≠ b_{i+1}.
